note: Gemini TTS roles (voice/gemini_tts.py, voice/humanize.py): one prebuilt Gemini voice + a style prompt per character. Never a cloned or famous voice. Chosen 15 Nov 2026 by the objective test below (voice-gemini.yml run 43711313236: one sentence with 12 deity names said by each voice, Whisper large-v3-turbo on the CPU, the Kaggle gate's exact-name rule) + gender/age fit; every production line is still Whisper-checked (any missed name -> that character falls back to edge-tts). Roles not listed (e.g. Mushak) keep edge-tts. Style prompts describe the VOICE, never a deity persona (15 Nov 2026: a 6-line chunk with an 'as Shri Krishna' persona and the sheesh-daan line came back finishReason SAFETY on gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview; the same line with a neutral style passed). A chunk that hits SAFETY is retried line by line.

krishna.style: Say in Hindi in a youthful, warm, loving and wise male voice, speaking gently to a dear friend: slow and soft, with a smile in the voice, real emotion and natural pauses, like a heartfelt storyteller

mahadev.style: Say in Hindi in a deep, calm, majestic male voice: slow and steady, loving and wise, every word with weight and warmth

parvati.style: Say in Hindi in a soft, loving, motherly female voice: gentle and warm, with tender affection

ganesh.style: Say in Hindi in the voice of a sweet, playful little boy of about eight: bright, innocent and excited, cute and lively

narad.style: Say in Hindi in a lively, cheerful, playful male voice, a little sing-song, full of energy, like a merry wandering sage

kartikeya.style: Say in Hindi in a brave, energetic young man's voice: confident, quick and spirited, with boyish warmth

nandi.style: Say in Hindi in a gentle, humble, devoted male voice: warm and calm

narrator.style: Say in Hindi, as a warm devotional storyteller (sutradhar): calm, clear and gentle, with feeling

facts.style: Say in Hindi, as a dramatic mystery storyteller revealing a little-known fact: curious and intriguing, building suspense, lowering the voice for secrets and lifting it for the reveal, clear and not too fast

jaikara.style: Call out in Hindi with full devotional power, like the leader of a temple crowd's jaikara: loud, proud and stirring, stretching the last word

lessons: Whisper writes नारद जी as नारजी for EVERY voice (and edge-tts): never put जी right after नारद in a script line (say नारद मुनि).
श्रीकृष्ण is heard as श्री कृष्ण (space) by every voice: scripts say कृष्ण or श्री कृष्ण, never the joined form.
Most voices: कान्हा -> कानहा, बर्बरीक -> बरबरीक/बर्बरी, भोलेनाथ -> भोले नाथ, श्याम -> शाम (the known Whisper bias): the per-line check falls back to edge-tts for such lines' speaker.
